key_highlights: ASX treads water as RBA Governor Bullock's hawkish stance and 'higher-for-longer' rate narrative weigh on equities
Iron ore downside persists, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; China political instability (Xi under fire) adds demand risk
WA/SA gold exploration surge: Great Southern 10.72g/t hit, Broken Hill resource uplift, Forrestania and Platina ground acquisitions
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' mode; auction activity cooling; fuel price shock (diesel/petrol) squeezing consumer margins
ASIC warns private credit investors may bail, raising systemic risk for ASX-listed credit funds
Super contributions surge >33% post-budget tax changes; new government-backed digital pension scheme proposed
Global: oil prices fall, chip stocks rally, Fed hiked despite Trump's 1% rate demand; Greenland rare-earth deal fuels critical metals

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces structural downside with China demand uncertainty; gold exploration active in WA/SA; rare-earth and critical metals gaining geopolitical tailwind from Greenland deal
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure on iron ore; gold juniors (Great Southern, Broken Hill, Forrestania, Platina) see positive catalysts; Dalaroo (DAR.AX) benefits from Greenland rare-earth narrative

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish bias (Bullock) supports NIMs but caps credit growth; ASIC private-credit warning creates overhang; housing stress threatens mortgage book quality
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rates but face rising NPL risk from Sydney housing downturn; private-credit exposure a key watch item

sectors.trend: Oil prices falling globally; domestic diesel/petrol shock rising, squeezing transport and consumer costs
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX face margin pressure from fuel cost pass-through; LNG names (SGS.AX, GWO.AX) relatively insulated but watch global oil trajectory

sectors.trend: Housing market 'bloodbath' in Sydney; auction reality check; rental market disruption; EV adoption accelerating
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure; WES.AX, WTW.AX squeezed by fuel and input costs; rental-tech disruptors gain attention

sectors.trend: Super contributions surge >33% post-budget; new digital pension scheme proposed; NDIS funding gaps highlighted
sectors.implications: Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) see AUM tailwind; CSL.AX, SGH.AX stable; NDIS policy risk a watch item

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot: Bullock signals higher-for-longer, reshaping rate expectations
Iron ore structural bear case with China political fragility
Gold and critical metals exploration boom in WA/SA/Greenland
Australian housing correction intensifying, particularly Sydney
Private credit sector under ASIC scrutiny
Super/pension reform wave: tax-driven contribution surge and new digital scheme
Fuel cost shock hitting consumer and transport sectors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA sustained hawkish policy / higher-for-longer rates
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; favour rate-sensitive banks with strong NIMs; hedge equity beta

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand deterioration / China political instability
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and critical metals exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Sydney housing market correction spilling into credit quality
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NPL data; underweight Sydney-heavy REITs; favour defensive consumer staples

risk_assessment.risk_factor: ASIC private credit warning / systemic credit stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review exposure to ASX-listed private credit vehicles; favour transparent, regulated credit products

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel price shock compressing consumer and transport margins
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight WES.AX, WTW.AX short-term; favour EV transition beneficiaries

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration and critical metals names
opportunities.rationale: WA/SA drill results (10.72g/t), Broken Hill resource uplift, Greenland rare-earth deal, and Dalaroo's geological breakthrough create a multi-catalyst setup

opportunities.recommendation: Add to major banks on rate tailwind, with NPL hedges
opportunities.rationale: Bullock hawkish stance supports NIMs; CBA and NAB best positioned; offset housing risk via credit default overlays
>33% contribution surge and new digital pension scheme expand AUM and fee revenue

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and thermal coal exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural iron ore downside with China political risk; oil falling globally

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Sydney-centric REITs and housing-linked equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing 'bloodbath' and auction cooling signal prolonged correction; credit quality risk to banks

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge against fuel cost shock in consumer/transport
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising diesel/petrol prices compress margins for WES, WTW, and logistics names

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. RBA hawkish bias, iron ore weakness, and Sydney housing stress cap upside. Gold/critical metals and bank NIMs provide selective pockets of strength. Fuel shock adds inflationary pressure, complicating RBA path.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots on inflation data. Super/pension reform wave and critical metals supply-chain reshoring offer structural tailwinds. Iron ore and housing remain key swing factors. China political risk is the dominant external wildcard.
